verses.text: Woe to the rebellious, defiled city that oppresses others!
She wouldn’t listen or accept correction. She didn’t trust the LORD or come near to her God.
Her officials are roaring lions; her judges are evening wolves that leave nothing for the morning.
Her prophets are reckless and treacherous. Her priests defile the sanctuary and violate the law.
The LORD within her is righteous; he does no wrong. Every morning he makes his justice clear; it never fails. But the unjust feel no shame.
“I have wiped out nations. Their towers are ruined. I have emptied their streets, so no one passes through. Their cities lie destroyed, with no people left.
I told Jerusalem, ‘Surely you’ll respect me and accept correction, so your home won’t be cut off, despite everything I had planned for you.’ But they got up early and corrupted all their actions.

“So wait for me,” says the LORD. “Wait for the day I rise to take the prey. I have decided to gather nations and assemble kingdoms, to pour out my fury and burning anger on them. The whole earth will be consumed by the fire of my jealousy.
“Then I will give the peoples pure speech, so everyone can call on the LORD’s name and serve him shoulder to shoulder.
“From beyond the rivers of Cush, my worshipers, even the daughter of my scattered people, will bring me an offering.
“On that day you won’t be ashamed of all your rebellious actions against me. I will remove from among you those who proudly celebrate, and you will never again act arrogantly on my holy mountain.
“I will leave among you a humble, poor people who take refuge in the LORD’s name.
“The remnant of Israel won’t do wrong or tell lies. No deceitful words will come from their mouths. They will eat and lie down, and no one will make them afraid.”
Sing, daughter of Zion! Shout, Israel! Celebrate and rejoice with all your heart, daughter of Jerusalem!
The LORD has removed your punishment and driven out your enemy. The King of Israel, the LORD, is among you; you won’t fear disaster anymore.
On that day Jerusalem will be told, “Don’t be afraid, Zion. Don’t let your hands fall limp.”
The LORD your God is with you, a mighty warrior who saves. He will take great joy in you. In his love he will calm you, and he will celebrate you with singing.”
“I will gather those who grieve because they can’t attend the appointed festivals. They are a burden and a disgrace to you.
“At that time I will deal with everyone who oppresses you. I will save the lame and gather the outcasts. I will turn their shame into praise and honor throughout the earth.
“At that time I will bring you home and gather you. I will give you honor and praise among all the peoples of the earth when I restore your fortunes before your eyes,” says the LORD.
